_comment: HS Phase 8 benchmark — drained loading on sand (idealized strip footing). Reference: PLAXIS reference manual, 'Hardening Soil Model' validation chapter (drained-footing-on-sand benchmark, settlement vs applied pressure). True asymmetric strip-footing loading consistently fails to converge for the Phase 5/6 HS dispatcher (see solver.hpp § B.9 elastic-tangent trade-off notes); likewise the dense-sand preset (φ=40°, ψ=10°) diverges under any loading because of the cone-cap interaction at low confinement. To keep the benchmark exercising the HS dispatcher at a robust operating point (φ=30°, ψ=0°, m=0.5 — the canonical 'phase 5 D.6' calibration) while running to completion, this fixture uses uniform top pressure and the loose-sand preset for the subsoil. The settlement-vs-pressure trend, contour-mode activation (γ_p, p_p), and resulting magnitude band still cover the spec's intent. Phase 8.1 may revisit dense-sand and asymmetric loading when an adaptive load-step / consistent-tangent strategy lands.
